  find "$1" -type f \( -name "*.fl" -o -name "*.go" -o -name "*.rs" -o -name "*.ts" -o -name "*.js" -o -name "*.py" \) -exec wc -l {} + | tail -1 | awk '{print $1}'

count_tests() {
  find "$1" -type f \( -name "*test*.fl" -o -name "*test*.go" -o -name "*test*.rs" \) | wc -l

for category in core modules archived experiments freelang-v5-ai tools; do

        lines=$(count_lines "$proj")
        tests=$(count_tests "$proj")

done
